description: This PHP script interacts with the TestLink API to add test cases to test plans. It sets up parameters for API calls, configures a client, and executes test additions with and without platforms.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class for making XML-RPC requests, used to communicate with the TestLink server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test by sending a request through the IXR_Client with specified method and arguments.
